$schema_note: Checked-in allowlist for the TEST-ONLY Family-1 underscore-named remainder of the import-hygiene CI gate (dev/import_hygiene_scan.py). Read by src/cadrumo/tests/test_import_hygiene_gate.py. Every entry here is a NAMED, REASONED test-only white-box reach into a private implementation symbol (a private repository-factory function, a private evaluator, a private module-level cache, a private constant that intentionally has no public promotion candidate) that was deliberately NOT promoted to a public facade (an underscore-named candidate gets an individual per-symbol disposition, not mechanical promotion; promoting an internals-only helper, a private cache, or a private constant onto a public facade would pollute the facade with implementation detail no other consumer needs). The gate FAILS if a NEW, undocumented test-only underscore-named private import appears that is not in this list; it does not fail if the count is lower. A production (non-test) violation is NEVER tolerated here -- this file governs test-only debt exclusively; see dev/import_hygiene_baseline.json for the production Family-1 cycle-break baseline.

test_only_family1_underscore_reaches._note: Each site is a test file reaching a foreign package's private submodule to exercise an internal helper, evaluator, repository factory, or module-private constant/cache by name. Grouped by owning package below for readability; the gate reads the flat 'sites' list.
